summary: Make the OSS-native Plugin Manager source-free and release-locked for connected container backends with CDN-hosted frontends.
userImpact: Operators can enable the isolated Plugin Manager through standard OSS deployment inputs without rebuilding it from source.
CDN-fronted installations receive an explicit same-origin plugin asset route and readiness contract.

instructions: Existing plugin deployments remain supported; adopt the optional digest-pinned Plugin Manager deployment kit when ready.

configuration: Adds optional digest-pinned Plugin Manager deployment, persistent plugin state, and CDN/plugin-asset routing configuration.

changes: Adds deployment readiness metadata for the native Plugin Manager and same-origin plugin asset route.
Retains exact compatibility for earlier patch releases within the current supported plugin SDK minor line.

notes: No database migration is planned for this deployment-only slice.

security: The Plugin Manager remains an isolated customer-local workload with no browser-facing service.
Registry and deployment credentials remain outside the browser and ordinary OSS backend.
documentation: Document the supported connected Compose backend and CDN-hosted frontend deployment path and label Kubernetes, OpenShift, and full air-gap delivery as preview.
Document the separation between internal product planning, repository technical documentation, and customer documentation.
knownLimitations: The public enterpriseglue.ai marketplace and commercial entitlement service remain outside this OSS change.
Kubernetes, OpenShift, multi-replica shared plugin assets, and complete commercial-plugin air-gap delivery remain preview until their deployment matrices pass.
rollback: Disable the optional Plugin Manager workload and continue using the existing installer CLI fallback.
validation: Validate Compose rendering, CDN route contracts, multi-architecture references, signed distribution metadata, and source-free deployment assets.
Run release-note, documentation-policy, and focused plugin deployment tests.
